show-wired.tooltip: Ethernet connection, with a panel listing every wired adapter

show-bluetooth.tooltip: Bluetooth radio, with a panel listing paired devices

show-wifi.tooltip: Wi-Fi radio, with a panel listing nearby networks

show-power.tooltip: Power profile, via power-profiles-daemon. Reads as on while Performance is selected

show-fan.tooltip: Fan strategy, via fw-fanctrl. Only useful on a Framework laptop with fw-fanctrl installed

show-awake.tooltip: Holds a systemd inhibitor and clears the screen timeouts, restoring them when switched off

body-toggles.description: Clicking a pill toggles it, the arrow opens its panel
body-toggles.tooltip: This is how GNOME's Quick Settings behave. Turn it off to swap the two halves round, so clicking the pill opens its panel and the arrow does the toggling

pill-padding.tooltip: Padding above and below the pill contents. Larger values make the whole grid taller

pill-radius.tooltip: 0 gives square corners; anything at or above half the pill height gives a full capsule

pill-icon-size.tooltip: Size of the symbolic icon inside each pill

pill-spacing.tooltip: Applies both across a row and between rows

use-theme-accent.description: Take the accent colour from the desktop theme
use-theme-accent.tooltip: Reads whatever the current theme paints a slider with, so the applet follows Mint-Y-Blue, -Orange, -Teal and the rest automatically

custom-accent.tooltip: Used for active pills, slider fills and panel badges

text-contrast.tooltip: Automatic picks dark or light from how bright the accent is, which keeps text readable on both a light orange and a dark blue

show-volume.tooltip: Volume slider, with an arrow opening the output and input device list

show-panel-brightness.tooltip: Laptop panel backlight. Has no effect on a desktop with no internal display

show-monitor-sliders.tooltip: Needs ddcutil installed and a monitor that speaks DDC/CI. Laptop panels do not

panel-show-battery-icon.tooltip: Turn off to fall back to a settings cog. Machines with no battery always show the cog

panel-show-percentage.tooltip: The number beside the icon in the panel

animate-panels.tooltip: Turn off to have panels appear immediately

animation-duration.tooltip: How long a panel takes to unfold. Around 150 to 250 feels responsive; higher starts to feel sluggish

prefetch-panels.description: Load panel contents as the popup opens
prefetch-panels.tooltip: Panel contents come from commands like nmcli and pactl, which take a moment. Reading them up front means a panel opens at its full size straight away instead of filling in. Turn off to only read them when a panel is actually opened
